KerrOrbitAuthority.EveryCpuConsumerShare.assertions: Original optionals present and EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ between shared authority, KerrSchildFamily ISCO, mass-scaled disk ISCO, disk angular velocity and transfer emitter angular velocity; three original extremal/zero-spin ISCO endpoint checks at mass2:12,2,18.
KerrOrbitAuthority.EveryCpuConsumerShare.independence_limit: Cross-consumer consistency against one shared CPU authority; not an independent general ISCO/orbit oracle or a check of every CPU consumer at every input.

KerrOrbitAuthority.UnrepresentedInputsDe.assertions: Five original invalid ISCO calls and five invalid angular-velocity calls decline; original two AccretionDiskD precondition death assertions. Inputs include nonpositive mass/radius, NaN, infinity, spin>mass and undefined retrograde denominator; no added refusal/domain boundary.

KerrZamoTransfer.ArbitraryLatitudeMatche.assertions: Independent Boyer-Lindquist metric gives omega=-g_tphi/g_phiphi, timelike norm, u^t and u^t(E-omega*L); original four EXPECT_NEAR comparisons at2e-15. Equatorial special-case consistency against disk ZAMO uses original EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ.
KerrZamoTransfer.ArbitraryLatitudeMatche.independence_limit: One original off-equatorial physical fixture; equatorial consistency is shared-production comparison, not another independent physical oracle.

KerrZamoTransfer.KerrSchildSlicingNormal.assertions: Original live inverse-metric Kerr-Schild slicing normal transformed to BL has abs(radial)>1e-3 and angular rate unequal to ZAMO; transfer exists. Finite witness distinguishing radial slicing motion from a stationary azimuthal ZAMO.

historical_execution.reuse_boundary: Two ZAMO names pass on a different historical oracle ELF; the two orbit names are absent. Bounded review of1460 preserved XML files found no selected current-producer execution. Historical results retained as historical, not relabelled; completed radiation/Page-Thorne controls excluded.

reference.independent_reference: Original KerrMetricD Boyer-Lindquist metric, u_phi=0 and u.u=-1, then invariant photon contraction. No new reference implementation or threshold.
reference.scope_boundary: Shared CPU orbit authority consistency and explicit refusal samples plus one original arbitrary-latitude ZAMO and slicing-normal fixture; no continuous-domain mathematical proof or final integrated qualification.

scope: Four original finite P4 CPU Kerr orbit/ZAMO controls only; no device/frame, all-spin/latitude/domain proof, full P4/science/Mandatory or release qualification.
